intro: The Space Coast is the single most distinctive listening destination in the United States. Launches from Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral generate range-safety, recovery-fleet and air-traffic activity across the AM airband and the military UHF band, and you can hear the operation building for hours before the vehicle leaves the pad. South of there, Miami Center handles Caribbean oceanic traffic, the Keys are a marine band paradise, and Orlando's theme parks run enormous radio operations of their own.
introz: 太空海岸是美国最独特的收听目的地。肯尼迪航天中心和卡纳维拉尔角的发射会在 AM 航空波段和军用 UHF 波段产生靶场安全、回收船队和空管的大量通话，而且在火箭离开发射台之前几个小时，你就能听到整个流程逐步展开。往南，迈阿密区调管理加勒比海洋区流量，群岛礁是海事波段的天堂，而奥兰多的主题公园自己就运行着规模庞大的通信网络。

stations.z: 发射日 · 扫整个航空波段
stations.d: Before a launch, temporary flight restrictions go up over the range and controllers spend hours clearing aircraft and boats out of the hazard area. That coordination happens on ordinary ATC frequencies and is the most reliable thing to hear. Sweep 118–136 MHz in AM from Titusville, Playalinda or Jetty Park a few hours before a window opens.
stations.dz: 发射前，靶场上方会设置临时飞行限制，管制员要花几个小时把飞机和船只清出危险区。这些协调就在普通空管频率上进行，是最稳定能听到的内容。在发射窗口前几小时，于 Titusville、Playalinda 或 Jetty Park 用 AM 扫 118–136 MHz。

stations.n: Eastern Range military UHF — scan 225–380 MHz
stations.z: 东部靶场军用 UHF · 扫 225–380 MHz
stations.d: Range operations, range-safety aircraft and Space Force activity use the military AM band, which the VX-6 covers. Sweep it in AM on launch day. Specific assignments are not published and change, so scanning beats chasing a number.
stations.dz: 靶场作业、靶场安全飞机和太空军的活动使用军用 AM 波段，VX-6 可以覆盖。发射日用 AM 扫这一段。具体频率不公开且会变动，所以扫描比追某个数字更有效。

stations.n: Marine Ch 16 — recovery and range clearance
stations.z: 海事 16 频道 · 回收与靶场清场
stations.d: The Coast Guard clears the offshore hazard area before every launch, and booster-recovery vessels work the same waters. On launch day this is often more interesting than the airband.
stations.dz: 每次发射前海岸警卫队都会清空近海危险区，助推器回收船也在同一片水域作业。发射日这里往往比航空波段更有意思。

stations.d: Launch windows live and die on weather. The forecast segments here tell you whether to bother driving out.
stations.dz: 发射窗口的生死取决于天气。这里的预报能告诉你今天值不值得开车过去。

stations.d: The main gateway to Latin America, with a heavy cargo operation overnight.
stations.dz: 通往拉美的主要门户，夜间货运业务繁重。

stations.z: 迈阿密区调 · 海洋与加勒比
stations.d: Miami Center controls traffic across the Caribbean and the Gulf. Sweep the enroute range from the Keys and you will hear position reports from aircraft a long way out over water.
stations.dz: 迈阿密区调管理加勒比海和墨西哥湾的流量。在群岛礁扫航路频段，能听到远在海上的航班位置报告。

stations.d: One of the busiest Coast Guard sectors in the country, covering the Florida Straits.
stations.dz: 全美最繁忙的海警分区之一，负责佛罗里达海峡。

stations.n: Marine Ch 72 — dive boats and charters
stations.z: 海事 72 频道 · 潜水船与包船
stations.d: Dive operators, charter captains and cruisers. The most human traffic on the Keys marine band.
stations.dz: 潜水公司、包船船长和巡航船。群岛礁海事波段上最有人味的内容。

stations.z: 海事 09 频道 · 呼叫
迈阿密港交管 14 频道
stations.d: Cruise ship movements, which in Miami is a genuinely large operation.
stations.dz: 邮轮进出港——在迈阿密这是相当大规模的作业。

stations.z: NOAA 迈阿密 / 西礁岛
stations.d: Hurricane season runs June to November and this is where the watches and warnings arrive first. The tropical weather segments are more detailed than anything on an app.
stations.dz: 飓风季从六月到十一月，警戒和警报最先在这里发布。热带天气部分比任何手机应用都详细。

stations.d: Central Florida has the highest lightning density in the United States. Afternoon storm warnings are genuinely useful.
stations.dz: 佛罗里达中部是全美闪电密度最高的地区，午后的雷暴警报确实有用。

stations.n: Theme park operations — FRS and GMRS
stations.z: 主题公园作业 · FRS 与 GMRS
stations.d: The Orlando parks run some of the largest coordinated radio operations of any private enterprise in the world. Much of it is on business channels, but ride crews, custodial teams and vendors put a great deal on the consumer bands. Sweep FRS and GMRS channels plus 464–469 MHz and you will get a sense of the machine behind the magic.
stations.dz: 奥兰多的主题公园运行着全球私营企业中规模最大的协调通信网络之一。相当一部分在商用频道上，但设施班组、清洁团队和商户大量使用民用频段。把 FRS、GMRS 频道加上 464–469 MHz 扫一遍，就能感受到魔法背后的那台机器。

stations.d: Hotels, resorts, convention centres and parks lease analog UHF business channels here. Still largely analog and very receivable.
stations.dz: 酒店、度假区、会展中心和乐园在这里租用模拟 UHF 商用频道，大部分仍是模拟制式，很容易收到。

stations.d: During a hurricane response these national mutual-aid channels stay analog and become genuinely active.
stations.dz: 飓风响应期间，这些全国互助频道仍是模拟制式，会变得非常活跃。

stations.d: Florida has an unusually well-organised amateur emergency network because of hurricanes. During a storm, listening to the SKYWARN and ARES nets is the closest thing to a live ground truth feed.
stations.dz: 因为飓风，佛罗里达的业余应急通信网络组织得异常完善。风暴期间收听 SKYWARN 和 ARES 通联网，几乎就是最接近现场实况的信息源。

stations.d: Storm-spotter nets activate on local repeaters during severe weather. Check RepeaterBook and the county ARES page before hurricane season.
stations.dz: 恶劣天气期间，风暴观测网会在本地中继上启动。飓风季前请查 RepeaterBook 和各县 ARES 页面。

stations.d: Ranger and airboat operations. Scan 162–174 MHz. Also worth checking around Biscayne and Dry Tortugas.
stations.dz: 护林员和气垫船作业。扫 162–174 MHz。Biscayne 和 Dry Tortugas 也值得一查。

stations.d: Long-running listener-supported community station.
stations.dz: 历史悠久的听众资助社区电台。

stations.n: Caribbean AM at night — scan 530–1710 kHz
stations.z: 夜间加勒比中波 · 扫 530–1710 kHz
stations.d: South Florida at night pulls in stations from Cuba, the Bahamas, Haiti and further into the Caribbean. Radio Habana Cuba is unmissable. One of the most interesting AM environments in the country.
stations.dz: 夜间的南佛罗里达能收到古巴、巴哈马、海地乃至更远加勒比地区的电台，哈瓦那电台尤其明显。全美最有意思的中波环境之一。

stations.d: Fitting to try from the Space Coast. Low latitude means the ISS passes closer to overhead here than anywhere else in the continental US.
stations.dz: 在太空海岸试这个格外应景。纬度低意味着国际空间站在这里过顶的仰角比美国本土任何地方都高。

stations.d: During hurricane season, decoding your own satellite image of a storm is an experience.
stations.dz: 飓风季自己解出一张风暴的卫星云图，是一种独特的体验。

stations.d: Also 4.724, 11.175 and 15.016 MHz. Hurricane Hunter aircraft also work HF during storm season.
stations.dz: 另有 4.724、11.175、15.016 MHz。风暴季“飓风猎人”飞机也使用短波通信。
